findingDetails.title: No test pins 5l silence on non-sk-code hubs
findingDetails.case: A refactor that drops or widens the basename gate makes check 5l print a PASS line on every hub; the clean-fixture assertions (fixed PASS id list plus a global no-FAIL/WARN match) never forbid an extra 5l line.
findingDetails.recommendation: Add assert.doesNotMatch(output, /: 5l:/m) to the clean-fixture test, or add a dedicated non-sk-code case.

findingDetails.title: The 5l FAIL message's two named fixes are not pinned by the tests
findingDetails.case: A future edit that trims the 5l FAIL message to the surface name keeps all three 5l tests green; only the surface name substring is asserted, never the two fix phrases.
findingDetails.recommendation: Extend test 1's detail assertion to also match one fix phrase, for example move them ahead, or add a regex match covering both fixes.

reviewDepthApplicability.reason: New doctor invariant plus its tests, a README sentence, and spec docs; the change has a user-facing failure mode on the operator's own repository.
